task: Panda Door Opening; existing Isaac Lab physics, reset, robot and Progress Reward B unchanged

expert.gate: Unselected validation success strictly greater than 90%; report Wilson 95% CI and all failures. No BC before this gate.

bc.B: same 26 robot channels + measured angle, target, progress, remaining, two contacts, handle xyz and quaternion wxyz
bc.capacity: Identical two 256-unit ReLU layers, tanh 7-action head; paired initial weights
bc.normalization: Train trajectories only; same robot normalization in both models; B measured environment features normalized, A padded with exact zeros
bc.sampling: Same seeded transition minibatch indices for A and B
bc.checkpoint_selection: Lowest validation action MSE evaluated each 1000 updates; final also retained
bc.primary_evaluation: Deterministic actions; 128 independent randomized episodes per model and seed; same resets and clone layout; fresh process per model
bc.secondary_evaluation: Normal action std=0.01 before tanh; independent fixed evaluation cohort
bc.statistics: Mean, seed SD and Student t 95% CI; paired differences with t CI, paired t test, exact sign-flip test; disclose n=5 resolution and assumptions
bc.anchor_gate: B mean success >50%, B-A mean >=10 percentage points, paired t 95% difference CI lower bound >0 and at least 4/5 positive seeds. Gate is tested on primary heldout cohort only.

diagnostics.action_sensitivity: Offline heldout robot states fixed; perturb angle within legal range and recompute progress/remaining coherently; also raw angle-only diagnostic
diagnostics.mask_value: Train mean (zero after normalization); fresh process and same reset seed for each condition
diagnostics.interpretation: Masking is an out-of-distribution intervention; require null/repeat reproducibility and distinguish redundant parameter channels

rl.status: Conditional on expert and BC anchor gates; not yet authorized by gate evidence
rl.guard: Log raw candidates separately from any recovery; never count protected recovery as learned improvement

prohibited: changes to Phase 1-12 artifacts or task
